objectives.name: Locate and Kill The Ferrous Wroughtnaut

title: The Living Armor
description:
Name: [Ferrous Wroughtnaut](image:tumblrbumblr:textures/quests/photos/wroughtnaut.png:150:150)
Known Locations: Underground
Estimated Size: Large
Behavior: Stationary until approached. Swings [Axe of a Thousand Metals](image:mowziesmobs:textures/item/wrought_axe_icon.png:50:50) in wide arcs. At 90% health, it will swing twice. At 60% health, it will swing twice and then spin. Will also stomp the ground, knocking back opponents and sending debris into the air. The Ferrous Wroughtnaut is immune to all forms of damage. It can only be hurt by exploiting the crack in its back, made vulnerable from behind after a large overhead swing makes its axe stuck.
Danger Level: §6§lMedium
